items.stem: Before designing training, a TD professional should first:

options.text: Assess whether a performance gap is actually a training need
options.rationale: Correct: needs assessment confirms training is the right solution.
Building content before analysis wastes effort.
Logistics come after the need is confirmed.

options.text: Pick a learning platform at random
options.rationale: Technology choice follows the identified need.

items.explanation: Correct: needs assessment confirms training is the right solution.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which evaluation choice best shows whether learning transferred to the job?

options.text: Measuring on-the-job behavior change after the course
options.rationale: Correct: behavior-level measures show transfer to work.
Attendance does not show learning or transfer.

options.text: Asking only if learners enjoyed it
options.rationale: Satisfaction alone does not prove transfer.
Slide count is unrelated to outcomes.

items.explanation: Correct: behavior-level measures show transfer to work.

items.stem: Select TWO adult learning principles that improve a training design.

options.text: Connecting new content to learners' existing experience
options.rationale: Correct: relevance to experience aids adult learning.
Correct: practice with feedback supports skill building.
Application is central to adult learning.

items.explanation: Correct: relevance to experience aids adult learning. Correct: practice with feedback supports skill building.
